reading: BBC News asked people with annual incomes ranging from £4,062 to £150,000 to assess this year's Budget.
Dave says he now pays around £350 a month for fuel for work and personal use, between 40% and 50% more than at the start of the year.
With an already strained household budget, Dave says higher fuel costs leave him little financial headroom.
The main rate of fuel duty, a tax on fuel, remains frozen at 57.95p per litre, but Dave disputes the suggestion that maintaining the rate amounts to giving motorists something.
He wanted a reduction in fuel duty and was disappointed that the Budget offered none.
Emily is frustrated that the government will await the outcome of a review of youth unemployment before legislating next year.
For the employment scheme, she favours reducing the eligibility threshold for time spent seeking work from 18 months to a year.
For Robert, renting a small flat would be his biggest concern, since it would absorb about two-thirds of his monthly wage.
His car costs £750 a month in finance, insurance, fuel and tax, yet he says he needs it for his commute to Newcastle Airport.
Chloe values paying a below-market rate for housing association accommodation, although she says sharing bills previously made life easier.
She welcomes the Budget, saying that even small changes give her hope.
Another interviewee wants higher earners such as himself to pay more tax in the interests of redistribution.
He says each of his daughters will begin working life with £45,000 to £60,000 in debt, with interest compounding at £5,000 to £8,000 a year.
While he accepts paying for university degrees, he argues that interest should be waived or capped below 1%.
Christine says she finds it difficult to balance the books and increasingly draws on savings to support herself.

She is unsure whether removing fixed charges from gas bills will benefit her, because transferring those costs to the unit rate, the price charged for each unit of gas consumed, could offset the saving.
She nevertheless expects the £100 household energy allowance to help over the winter.
Her overall assessment is that she may end up financially unchanged, rather than better off.

vocabulary.definition: The capacity within a budget to meet additional costs without financial difficulty.
A minimum requirement someone must meet to qualify for support or an opportunity; here, a specified period of seeking work.
Use up part of someone's available income, leaving less for other expenses.
A price lower than the amount normally charged for comparable accommodation or services.
The use of taxation and public support to shift income or wealth between groups, especially towards those with less.
Accumulating as interest is added to a debt and further interest is calculated on the enlarged amount.
Formally not required to be paid, although the charge would otherwise apply.
Restricted by an upper limit, without necessarily being removed.
Keep income and expenditure in balance so that costs do not exceed available money.
Reduce or cancel the financial effect of a saving through a cost elsewhere.

entries.ja: 追加の費用が生じても、経済的に困ることなく対応できる予算上の余裕。
entries.ko: 추가 비용이 생겨도 경제적인 어려움 없이 감당할 수 있는 예산상의 여유.
entries.zh-Hans: 预算中能够承担额外费用而不陷入财务困难的余地。
entries.es: Margen dentro de un presupuesto para afrontar gastos adicionales sin dificultades económicas.
entries.pt-BR: Folga no orçamento para arcar com custos adicionais sem dificuldades financeiras.
entries.fr: Marge dans un budget permettant de faire face à des frais supplémentaires sans difficulté financière.
entries.de: Der Spielraum innerhalb eines Budgets, zusätzliche Kosten ohne finanzielle Schwierigkeiten zu decken.

entries.ja: 支援を受けたり機会を得たりする資格を満たすために必要な最低条件。ここでは、求職活動を続けた期間について定められた条件。
entries.ko: 지원이나 기회를 얻을 자격을 갖추기 위해 충족해야 하는 최소 요건. 여기서는 정해진 구직 활동 기간을 뜻하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 获得支持或机会所必须达到的最低要求；这里指规定的求职时长。
entries.es: Requisito mínimo que una persona debe cumplir para acceder a una ayuda o una oportunidad; aquí, un período determinado de búsqueda de empleo.
entries.pt-BR: Requisito mínimo que uma pessoa precisa cumprir para ter direito a um apoio ou a uma oportunidade; neste caso, um período determinado de busca por trabalho.
entries.fr: Condition minimale à remplir pour avoir droit à une aide ou accéder à une opportunité ; ici, une durée déterminée de recherche d’emploi.
entries.de: Eine Mindestanforderung, die jemand erfüllen muss, um Anspruch auf Unterstützung oder Zugang zu einer Möglichkeit zu haben; hier eine festgelegte Dauer der Arbeitssuche.

entries.ja: 使える収入の一部を費やし、ほかの支出に回せるお金を減らすこと。
entries.ko: 쓸 수 있는 소득의 일부를 소모하여 다른 지출에 쓸 수 있는 돈을 줄이다.
entries.zh-Hans: 消耗某人可支配收入的一部分，使其可用于其他开支的钱减少。
entries.es: Consumir parte de los ingresos disponibles de una persona, dejando menos dinero para otros gastos.
entries.pt-BR: Consumir parte da renda disponível de alguém, deixando menos dinheiro para outras despesas.
entries.fr: Utiliser une partie du revenu disponible d’une personne, lui laissant moins d’argent pour d’autres dépenses.
entries.de: Einen Teil des verfügbaren Einkommens einer Person aufbrauchen, sodass weniger Geld für andere Ausgaben bleibt.

entries.ja: 同程度の住居やサービスに通常かかる金額よりも低い価格。
entries.ko: 비슷한 수준의 주거 시설이나 서비스에 보통 부과되는 금액보다 낮은 가격.
entries.zh-Hans: 低于同类住房或服务通常收费水平的价格。
entries.es: Precio inferior al que se suele cobrar por alojamientos o servicios comparables.
entries.pt-BR: Preço inferior ao que normalmente se cobra por moradias ou serviços semelhantes.
entries.fr: Prix inférieur à celui habituellement demandé pour des logements ou des services comparables.
entries.de: Ein Preis, der unter dem Betrag liegt, der üblicherweise für vergleichbare Unterkünfte oder Dienstleistungen verlangt wird.

entries.ja: 税金や公的支援を通じて、集団間で所得や富の配分を変えること。特に、所得や富が少ない人々により多く行き渡るようにすること。
entries.ko: 세금과 공적 지원을 통해 집단 간에 소득이나 부가 배분되는 방식을 바꾸는 것. 특히 소득이나 부가 적은 사람들에게 더 돌아가도록 하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过税收和公共援助，在不同群体之间转移收入或财富，尤其是向收入或财富较少的人倾斜。
entries.es: Uso de los impuestos y las ayudas públicas para transferir ingresos o riqueza entre grupos, especialmente hacia quienes tienen menos.
entries.pt-BR: Uso de impostos e apoio público para transferir renda ou riqueza entre grupos, especialmente para quem tem menos.
entries.fr: Utilisation de l’impôt et des aides publiques pour transférer des revenus ou des richesses entre différents groupes, en particulier vers ceux qui en ont moins.
entries.de: Der Einsatz von Steuern und staatlicher Unterstützung, um Einkommen oder Vermögen zwischen Gruppen umzuverteilen, insbesondere zugunsten derjenigen, die weniger haben.

entries.ja: 利息が借金に加算され、その増えた金額をもとにさらに利息が計算されることで、積み重なっていくこと。
entries.ko: 이자가 빚에 더해지고 그렇게 늘어난 금액을 기준으로 다시 이자가 계산되면서 계속 쌓이는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 随着利息计入债务，并以增加后的金额计算新的利息而不断累积。
entries.es: Acumularse a medida que los intereses se añaden a una deuda y se calculan nuevos intereses sobre el importe aumentado.
entries.pt-BR: Acumular-se à medida que os juros são adicionados a uma dívida e novos juros são calculados sobre o valor aumentado.
entries.fr: S’accumuler à mesure que les intérêts s’ajoutent à une dette et que de nouveaux intérêts sont calculés sur le montant ainsi augmenté.
entries.de: Sich anhäufen, indem Zinsen zu einer Schuld hinzugerechnet und auf den dadurch erhöhten Betrag weitere Zinsen berechnet werden.

entries.ja: 通常なら支払いが必要な料金について、正式に支払いを免除されたこと。
entries.ko: 원래는 내야 하는 요금이나 비용에 대해 공식적으로 납부 의무가 면제된 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 原本适用的费用被正式免除，无须支付。
entries.es: Que no se exige pagar por una exención formal, aunque normalmente se cobraría.
entries.pt-BR: Dispensado oficialmente de pagamento, embora normalmente fosse devido.
entries.fr: Dont le paiement n’est officiellement pas exigé, alors qu’il le serait normalement.
entries.de: Offiziell erlassen, sodass der sonst fällige Betrag nicht bezahlt werden muss.

entries.ja: 必ずしもなくなるわけではなく、上限を設けて制限されたこと。
entries.ko: 반드시 없어지는 것은 아니며, 상한선이 정해져 제한된 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 受到上限限制，但并不一定被取消。
entries.es: Limitado por un máximo, sin que necesariamente se elimine.
entries.pt-BR: Limitado por um valor máximo, sem necessariamente ser eliminado.
entries.fr: Soumis à une limite maximale, sans être nécessairement supprimé.
entries.de: Durch eine Obergrenze beschränkt, ohne notwendigerweise ganz wegzufallen.

entries.ja: 支出が使えるお金を超えないように、収入と支出の釣り合いを保つこと。
entries.ko: 지출이 쓸 수 있는 돈을 넘지 않도록 수입과 지출의 균형을 유지하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 保持收支平衡，使支出不超过可用资金。
entries.es: Mantener equilibrados los ingresos y los gastos para que estos no superen el dinero disponible.
entries.pt-BR: Manter receitas e despesas equilibradas, de modo que os gastos não ultrapassem o dinheiro disponível.
entries.fr: Maintenir l’équilibre entre les revenus et les dépenses afin que les dépenses ne dépassent pas l’argent disponible.
entries.de: Einnahmen und Ausgaben im Gleichgewicht halten, sodass die Kosten das verfügbare Geld nicht übersteigen.

entries.ja: 別のところで費用がかかることによって、節約による金銭的な効果を減らしたり、打ち消したりすること。
entries.ko: 다른 곳에서 발생하는 비용으로 인해 절약의 금전적 효과를 줄이거나 없애다.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过其他方面产生的费用，减少或抵消节省开支所带来的经济效果。
entries.es: Reducir o anular el efecto económico de un ahorro mediante un gasto en otro concepto.
entries.pt-BR: Reduzir ou anular o efeito financeiro de uma economia por meio de um custo em outra parte.
entries.fr: Réduire ou annuler l’effet financier d’une économie par un coût supplémentaire ailleurs.
entries.de: Die finanzielle Wirkung einer Einsparung durch Kosten an anderer Stelle verringern oder aufheben.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
